speaker: Mr Pritam Singh
text: asked the Minister for Manpower (a) whether the Ministry will detail the number of new jobs filled by Singaporeans, PRs and foreigners respectively for each industry covered by the Industry Transformation Maps (ITMs) henceforth; and (b) whether it can provide these statistics for each ITM since the inception of the respective ITMs to date.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Changes in workforce profile depend on a variety of factors which can be structural or cyclical in nature.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: To assess the impact of ITMs, it will be more meaningful to look at employment outcomes over the medium and long terms.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Nonetheless, we can look at employment changes across the 23 ITM sectors from 2015, before the launch of ITMs, to 2018.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: These numbers are encouraging because we have been making the effort to secure jobs for Singaporeans.

speaker: The Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
text: Singaporeans have consistently worked hard to update our skills and stay relevant.
